title: [spec] document canonical-PIV (nonzero-length) requirement and its interop consequences
description: P3 informational finding, no code change. Wrapper coap_oscore.c:194 (new this wave) rejects 0-length PIV with INVALID_PARAM -> 4.01; C client encodes seq 0 as 1-byte 0x00 PIV (oscore_nonce.c:66-69) and core oscore_protect.c:400 already rejected empty PIV pre-wave, so LICHEN-LICHEN interop is intact. But RFC 8613 permits 0-length PIV (seq 0), so RFC-conformant third-party peers are rejected. Document the canonical-PIV convention in the security/interop spec section (draft-lora-security-* or spec 6) with rationale (canonical encoding, replay-window simplicity) and note the interop boundary explicitly.
